changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The 1.0 cutover (#2656) copied each earlier review invocation into review_job as a terminal job. An invocation with nothing left to deliver got processing_status NONE, and its review carries checks.MIGRATION. Nothing settles such a job again, but NONE marks a job that settlement still owes. Mark these jobs DONE, so that NONE and PENDING mean one thing: settlement has not run yet.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE review_job j SET processing_status = 'DONE' FROM review r WHERE r.id = j.review_id AND r.workspace_id = j.workspace_id AND r.id = j.id AND jsonb_exists(r.checks, 'MIGRATION') AND j.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'CANCELLED') AND j.processing_status = 'NONE';

rollback.stop: Restore the backup taken before this upgrade: the corrected rows are not marked.
